name: nexa-audiolm-instuct-benchmark
description: A Hugging Face dataset designed to evaluate AudioLM-style instruction-following and audio generation capabilities. It contains instruction-response pairs (audio and/or text) for testing how well models follow spoken or written instructions to produce appropriate audio outputs. Evaluation emphasizes perceptual quality and instruction fidelity.
evaluation_method: human_eval (MOS and semantic fidelity via human raters; may be supplemented by ASR-based automatic checks)
general_score_metric: human_eval (MOS / correctness of generated audio vs. instruction)
reputation: Relatively new community dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing adoption among audio-generation researchers.
